purpose: Address the retained product-cancellation centroid and thin-triangle failures through a separate host arithmetic law, without substituting literal BETSE arithmetic.

diagnostic.centroid_finding: Fsum of already-rounded terms cannot recover lost cross-product/numerator bits; both translated float64 variants still exceeded the original budget. Exact binary rational evaluation matched the selected reference bits.
diagnostic.triangle_finding: Heron side-length and subtraction errors dominate the thin triangle. Determinant area with the same side lengths passed the selected fixed budget; sorted Kahan Heron alone still failed.

input_domain.coordinates: Explicit list/tuple rows of two finite Python binary64 floats. Literal integers up to absolute 2**53 are converted exactly. No boolean, Decimal, ndarray or wider-float coercion.
input_domain.polygon: Distinct vertices in the caller's simple boundary order. Concavity and forward collinear edges are allowed. Repeated, crossing, touching nonadjacent and backtracking edges are refused with explicit codes.
input_domain.triangle: Three distinct, exactly noncollinear supplied points; orientation does not change positive area or radii.
input_domain.floating_environment: Binary radix, 53-bit mantissa, exponents -1021/1024; runtime probes require nearest-even and gradual underflow before evaluating geometry.
input_domain.representation: Every required output must round to finite binary64. A nonzero exact output rounding to zero is refused, as is overflow. Unresolved bounded exact rounding is refused rather than approximated.
input_domain.caller_options: No adjustable tolerance, fallback threshold or rounding budget. The 32-ULP policy and bounded refinement schedule belong to the versioned law.

arithmetic.fast_path: Local-coordinate triangle-fan polygon moments and a local circumcenter solve. Area uses a determinant; circumradius is the norm of the local centre offset. No Heron area is used in production.
arithmetic.enclosure: Propagate outward binary64 endpoint bounds through basic operations. Sum bounds use outward sequential addition; fsum supplies only a candidate and is not assumed to recover exact product bits. Square roots are bracketed and checked using exact integer squared comparisons.
arithmetic.certification: Accept a candidate only if the complete enclosure lies within 32 ULPs of that candidate. Unresolved zero coordinates and uncertain denominators cause exact fallback. The criterion has no fixture-specific absolute floor.
arithmetic.predicates: Filtered orientation signs with exact binary rational fallback. Boundary-order validation is confined to the supplied primitive and supplies no whole-mesh topology qualification.
arithmetic.rational_fallback: Re-evaluate the complete affected primitive from original binary64 coordinates using exact Fraction arithmetic. Do not reuse rounded differences or products. Polygon moments and centre/area ratios round once to binary64.
arithmetic.sqrt_fallback: Use integer isqrt on scaled exact radicands to construct dyadic lower/upper bounds. Resolve radius and inradius only when both endpoints round to the same binary64 result. Refine at 80,160,320,640,1280,2560,5120,8192 bits; retain and refuse unresolved rounding.
arithmetic.provenance: Record the selected method, fallback reason, predicate counters, complete input/output hex encodings, exact ratios or intervals and the versioned policy.

independent_reference.dependencies: Standard-library integers and Decimal only; no Fraction arithmetic or production/scientific-package imports.
independent_reference.rational_definitions: Scale original float ratios onto a common exact integer grid. Use global edge shoelace moments and global integer circumcenter determinants, independently of the production local fan and translated Fraction expressions.
independent_reference.decimal_definitions: Preserve separate global Decimal shoelace, pivoted perpendicular-bisector Gaussian solve, radius and high-precision Heron outputs. Authoritative rational quantities and squared circumradius are also evaluated from the independent integer grid.
independent_reference.precision: Primary max(4096,6*input_decimal_span+160) digits; refined primary+512 digits; refuse above 16384 digits. Retain full decimal strings and both precision reports before comparison.
independent_reference.rounding_controls: Use exact integer nearest-neighbour/ties-to-even comparisons for rational output hex targets, including exact-zero and midpoint cases.
independent_reference.comparison: Compare actual binary64 values directly with full-precision decimal targets, not shortened displays or only rounded reference floats. Verify reported enclosures and exact rational identities independently.
independent_reference.fresh_process: Deny Cells, BETSE, NumPy, SciPy, JAX, Torch and Pillow before provider import. Reconstruct declared input recipes and compare saved independent reports. No native-equivalence lane exists.

controls.transforms: Apply exact rational affine recipes, round transformed coordinates once and retain every coordinate quantization ratio. Exact affine/order invariance is asserted only when the transformed binary64 inputs equal the exact recipe. Otherwise compare the changed inputs independently without an invariance claim.
controls.regular_polygon: The 64-point manufactured polygon uses recorded math.sin/cos binary64 coordinates; no ideal regular-polygon geometry is claimed.
controls.original_failures: Retain both original input bit records and native failure outputs unchanged. Assert the saved failures still exceed their fixed budget; passing a new primitive never changes the old campaign status.

tolerances.fast_path: At most 32 ULPs of the actual binary64 candidate, checked against full-precision references and the stored enclosure.
tolerances.rational_fallback: Correctly rounded exact ratio and matching independent rounded target bits.
tolerances.sqrt_fallback: Both exact dyadic interval endpoints round to the emitted value; compare independent high-precision targets and retain full intervals.
tolerances.reference_resolution: At most 0.01 ULP and 0.1 of the fixed comparison budget.
tolerances.failure_policy: Preserve all declared cases, refusals and errors. Do not move fixtures, widen budgets, silently substitute a method or reclassify prior failures to pass.

ownership: Requests and results are immutable tuples/frozen records; identity seals input bits, method and certificates. Caller list aliases and resealed mutable/untyped records do not obtain result authority.
artifact_policy: Independent guarded workers and finalization; one JSON record at a time, 16-MiB metadata bound, streamed file/runtime/library hashes. Preserve raw output before assertions, unexpected completions and partial guard failures. Long qualification launches detached; no automatic polling or retry.
